articles.title: Crypto poured years into new products. The next challenge is keeping users
articles.snippet: Crypto firms have spent years building financial products on blockchains. Getting people to use them — and keep using them — is becoming the next challenge.

articles.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

articles.title: Trump’s potential AI czar, Jay Clayton, helped pioneer the SEC’s crypto crackdown
articles.snippet: The former SEC chairman who may be tapped to oversee the Trump administration's AI work has a potentially divisive history as a watchdog of tech innovation.

articles.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin after more than a decade
articles.snippet: A Tether-backed project, Utexo, plans to support private USDT transfers, direct swaps between BTC and USDT and loans backed by BTC, while keeping most transaction data off Bitcoin’s public ledger.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin posts tentative gains as rates drop ahead of Friday's jobs report
articles.snippet: The euro is losing ground versus the greenback as spiking French bond yields revive memories of the European sovereign debt crisis.
